title: HaloScan synthetic evaluation
disclaimer: All numbers below are from a procedural X-ray generator. They are not clinical sensitivity, not a reader study, and not a comparison that shows HaloScan outperforming the Emory 2020 radiograph model. A research flag is not a diagnosis and must not be used to discharge or to delay emergency care.

definitions.battery_research_flag_sensitivity: Fraction of synthetic battery images on which the research flag is raised. Not clinical sensitivity.
definitions.coin_pattern_rate: Fraction of synthetic single-coin images called coin-like, without the research flag and without the ambiguity rewrite.
definitions.stacked_research_flag_rate: Fraction of synthetic stacked-coin images on which the research flag or ambiguity path fires. Reported separately from battery classification.
definitions.wilson95: Wilson score 95% interval. A point estimate of 1.0 on a small n still has a lower bound below 1.
definitions.threshold_curve: Battery-like score threshold on the ensemble's normalized battery score, not the ambiguity rules.
definitions.training_label_collapse: classifier.build_dataset maps stacked coins to the battery class (0). The CNN is trained to call stacks batteries. That is not an independent stacked-coin detector.

dataset.holdout_description: Fresh generate_sample draws. Same painter as training: concentric rings for batteries, flat discs for coins, copied rings plus an offset rim for stacks, stick-figure ribs for background.
dataset.shift_description: generate_shifted_sample: smaller frame, edge-biased placement, gamma, JPEG quality 30-55, extra noise, and a dark bar.
dataset.pairing: AP and lateral are separate random draws with related seeds, not a projective pair of one object. On the 2026-10-11 holdout, DualViewNet alone called every synthetic coin a battery when a lateral was attached (cnn_only coin-pattern rate 0.0). Classical AP and AP-only CNN still separated coins. As of 2026-10-12 the ensemble applies a dual-view collapse guard: when DualViewNet predicts battery but AP-only CNN and classical profiling agree on coin, fusion uses AP-only network scores. The cnn_only ablation still reports the raw DualViewNet failure.
dataset.leakage: The shipped checkpoint was fit by build_dataset without a fixed seed, so exact image identity with this holdout is unlikely, but the images come from the same generator family. This is not a locked unused split from the original training run.
dataset.legacy_metrics_note: Legacy metrics.json used seeds 0..n-1 (battery), 2000+ (coin), and 3000+ (stacked) with emergency defined as battery_probability >= 0.5 or emergency flag. Those figures are synthetic point estimates.
dataset.real_radiographs: No appropriately licensed de-identified pediatric foreign-body set was available in this repository. No external clinical evaluation was run.
